title: Settings ON reveals its indented sub-toggles
expected: 6 indented sub-toggles in order: App Settings, Service, Parts, Finance, Data Import, View/Manage Wages
actual: Toggling Settings ON revealed exactly 6 indented sub-toggles in order: App Settings, Service, Parts, Finance, Data Import, View/Manage Wages. No 7th 'Integrations' sub-toggle (matches the case's noted build-vs-spec gap).
reason: Matches expected (6 subs in order; Integrations absent as the case documents)

title: Settings parent OFF hides the 6 sub-toggles
actual: With Settings ON there were 6 sub-toggles; toggling Settings OFF collapsed them to 0 (none visible).

title: Saved role with Settings OFF: hides the SETTINGS sidebar group entirely
expected: SETTINGS sidebar group hidden - none of Company settings/Staff/Roles & Permissions/etc visible
actual: Tech assigned a role with no settings sub-permissions. Navigating to /administration redirected to /workorders - the entire settings/administration area is inaccessible and no SETTINGS group appears.
reason: Matches expected: Settings-off role has no SETTINGS group / admin area

title: Toggling Settings parent OFF then ON PRESERVES the 6 sub-toggle selections
expected: After OFF then ON: App Settings+Service+Wages still ON, Parts+Finance+Data Import still OFF
actual: Set App Settings=ON, Service=ON, Wages=ON (Parts/Finance/Data Import OFF). Toggled Settings OFF (subs hidden), then ON: subs reappeared with App Settings=ON, Service=ON, View/Manage Wages=ON, Parts=OFF, Finance=OFF, Data Import=OFF - exactly preserved.
reason: Matches expected: selections preserved across parent off/on

title: App Settings sub-toggle ON enables Roles & Permissions / Staff
expected: Company settings, Staff, Roles & Permissions visible in sidebar
actual: With App Settings ON, the SETTINGS sidebar group showed Settings (Company settings), Staff, Roles & Permissions (plus Locations, Departments, Taxes).

title: Service sub-toggle ON enables Service config sidebar items (Labor Rates / Canned Lines / Vehicle Types)
expected: SERVICE group visible with Labor Rates, Canned Lines, Vehicle Types
actual: With Service ON (and all else off), the SERVICE group appeared with Labor Rates, Canned Lines, Asset Types, and Inspection Templates. Labor Rates and Canned Lines match; 'Vehicle Types' is now labeled 'Asset Types' in the current build.
reason: Matches expected behavior (Service sub enables SERVICE config group). Note: 'Vehicle Types' item is now named 'Asset Types'.

title: Parts sub-toggle ON enables Parts config sidebar items (Pricing / Categories)
expected: PARTS group with Pricing and Categories visible
actual: PARTS sidebar group showed Pricing, Bin Locations, and Categories.

title: Finance sub-toggle ON enables Finance items including QuickBooks (relocated from Integrations)
expected: FINANCE group with Payment Methods visible; QuickBooks entry present in Finance (not under Integrations)
actual: FINANCE sidebar group showed only 'Payment Methods'. There was NO QuickBooks entry in Finance, nor anywhere else. The INTEGRATIONS group showed only 'IBS' (no QuickBooks).
reason: Contradicts expected: QuickBooks is not present in the Finance group (nor anywhere). Payment Methods is present, but the required QuickBooks entry is missing.

title: Data Import sub-toggle ON enables Imports sidebar items
expected: IMPORTS group visible with Contacts, Assets, Vendors, Inventory, Invoices
actual: IMPORTS sidebar group showed Contacts, Assets, Vendors, Inventory, Invoices - all five present.

title: View/Manage Wages sub-toggle ON enables wage management
expected: Wage rate fields visible and editable
actual: With Wages ON, opening a staff member's 'Edit Staff Member' modal showed editable wage fields: 'Salary Type' (Hourly dropdown) and '$ Hourly Rate' input.
reason: Matches expected: wage rate fields visible and editable

title: Sub-toggles operate independently (Service ON, Finance OFF)
expected: SERVICE items present; FINANCE items absent
actual: With only Service ON, sidebar showed the SERVICE group (Labor Rates, Canned Lines, Asset Types, Inspection Templates) and NO FINANCE group (and no other settings groups).

title: Turning off the last Settings sub auto-collapses the section
expected: Turning off the last enabled Settings sub-toggle auto-collapses the section
actual: With Settings parent ON and only App Settings ON, turning App Settings OFF (the last enabled sub) auto-set the Settings parent to OFF and collapsed all 6 sub-toggles (0 visible).
reason: Matches the case title/expected: last-sub-off auto-collapses the section
